_meta.purpose: Automated first-pass IP screen. Catches obvious hits and high-risk SHAPES. It is not a substitute for a database check - it is the filter that stops the obvious 95% before a human looks at the rest.
_meta.scope: Screen ALL text that ships: artwork copy, title, tags, description, and backend search terms. Trademark attaches to use in commerce, so a clean image with a franchise name in the tags is still an infringement.

R0.label: Original art, original phrasing, generic vocabulary

R1.label: Common phrase that could plausibly be registered
R1.action: database check required; record in ip.screened_against[]

R2.label: Genre or scene aesthetic adjacent to a franchise
R2.action: verify no protected string appears anywhere; ship the vibe only

R3.label: Public-domain source
R3.action: verify term in selling jurisdictions AND verify the scan's own rights

R4.label: Any protected name, logo, character, or likeness

forbidden_categories: franchise, film, game, or series names
band names, album titles, song lyrics
company names, product names, logotypes, wordmarks
sports teams, leagues, universities, and their colours in a varsity lockup
living public figures' names and likenesses
look-alike designs recognisable as a protected property
'in the style of' a living artist
operating system chrome, icons, or logotypes
fashion house names, monograms, and trade dress
the NPS arrowhead, NASA insignia and wordmark, and tourism-board logos

high_risk_patterns.reason: Signals derivative use of protected IP
Trademark symbol implies a registered mark
Trademark or copyright symbol in shipped text

high_risk_patterns.pattern: (?i)\b(marvel|disney|pixar|nintendo|pokemon|star wars|harry potter|hogwarts|lord of the rings|tolkien|elden ring|dark souls|cyberpunk 2077|one piece|naruto|dragon ball|call of duty|warhammer|baldur'?s gate|league of legends|arcane|fallout|minecraft|roblox|fortnite|avatar the last airbender|studio ghibli|sanrio|hello kitty|barbie|lego|nike|adidas|supreme|gucci|chanel|louis vuitton|prada|starbucks|coca.?cola|netflix|spotify|playstation|xbox|apple|google|amazon prime)\b

high_risk_patterns.reason: Protected music mark or personal name

phrase_shapes_requiring_check.shape: any short declarative slogan of 2-6 words on apparel
phrase_shapes_requiring_check.reason: Short phrases are exactly what gets registered as marks
Must verify the invented brand is not a real one

phrase_shapes_requiring_check.shape: a place name plus a varsity lockup
phrase_shapes_requiring_check.reason: Verify no school, club or team owns that lockup

vibe_substitutions.a named soulslike: soulslike difficulty humour, you died again
vibe_substitutions.a named band: 90s shoegaze, underground techno, old-school punk, sad-girl indie, midwest emo
vibe_substitutions.a named anime: shonen training-arc energy, magical-girl transformation aesthetic

archives: US National Park / WPA poster archive
public-domain maps, star charts and patent drawings
expired vintage travel, transit and exhibition posters
caveats: Verify the term in every jurisdiction you sell into - terms differ between the US, UK and EU.
A modern photograph or scan of a public-domain work can carry its own rights. Use verified open-access sources.
Reproduction is legal but undifferentiated. FUSION - a public-domain composition plus one modern motif - is what actually sells.

databases.name: Amazon Brand Registry
databases.scope: required before using any tagline or stylised text on Merch

review_cadence: Re-screen the live catalogue quarterly. Trademarks are registered continuously - a phrase clear today may not be clear in six months.
